note:
R72 - gen7 EALayer3 v1 (SNS codec 0x05; PS3 09-Legacy pbp/ann, X360 15/Legacy pbp): open the block payloads as bounded structures on
their OWN vectors, without assuming the PS4 0x0b sized-frame grammar (coordinator review 2026-09-22 F2 / next task). Read-only.

Per bank (default 8 samples: first, last, evenly spaced distinct offsets), per sample: SNR words, the SNS block chain (declared samples,
payload bytes), then on every data-block payload:

  T1 size-prefix readings   u8@0, u16be@0, u16le@0, u16be@1, u16le@1, u24be@0, u24be@1, each as 'size includes prefix' / 'size excludes
                            prefix' and masked (& 0x7fff / & 0x0fff): does the chain of sizes tile the payload exactly? Count per reading.
                            (This is the PS4 0x0b test; it is expected to FAIL here and the failure is recorded exactly.)
  T2 leading bytes          histogram of the first 1 / 2 / 4 bytes of the first block and of later blocks; whether byte 0 is constant;
                            whether byte 1 is constant within a sample-rate class and differs between 24 000 and 44 100 Hz banks.
  T3 samples per block      declared samples per block: histogram, gcd, whether every block is a multiple of 576 (one Layer III granule)
                            and 1 152 (one MPEG-1 frame); payload bytes per declared sample.
  T4 granule side-info grammar   MPEG Layer III mono side info per granule has a FIXED bit length (59 bits MPEG-1, 63 bits MPEG-2,
                            independent of window switching). Hypothesis family: block = [h header bits] then, per granule g of
                            G = samples / 576: [e extra bits][side info][main data of part2_3_length bits] (interleaved), or
                            [e + side info] x G then all main data (side-first). For every h in 0..64, e in 0..40, both layouts and both
                            side-info lengths, count the blocks whose granule chain tiles the payload to within byte padding, with
                            plausibility (big_values <= 288, 90 <= global_gain <= 240). The best reading, its tiling count and its
                            plausibility are published; if none tiles, that is the recorded failure.
                            A bit reservoir (main_data_begin > 0) would break per-granule tiling: the side-first layout also tests
                            'sum of part2_3_length == main data bits' without per-granule tiling.

Usage: python r72_gen7_ealayer3_structure.py <out.json> [--trees x360-nhl15,ps3-nhl13] [--banks pbp_eng,ann_eng] [--per-bank 8]
